title: How to Create a Zen-like Agile Software Development Team | HatchWorks AI
description: Having a high-performing Agile software development team is like reaching the ultimate state of zen. When you experience it, you just know…The team works with a subconscious intuition, operating as a unit seemingly knowing what each other is thinking, all guided by a common purpose and product vision.
